name: Eric Melloul
current_role: Chairman of the Board, Oatly Group AB; independent lead director, The Vita Coco Company; Senior Advisor (ex-Managing Director), Verlinvest
profile: Consumer-goods investor who spent 2008-2024 as a Managing Director of Verlinvest, the Brussels-based de Mevius family investment firm, where he backed Vita Coco (board since ~2008-2010) and Oatly (board since Nov 2016; now chairman). Earlier at AB InBev and McKinsey. SEC-reported holdings relate to these board/insider positions.
interesting_fact: Told Foodinc in 2021 that Oatly was the first company in Verlinvest's food & beverage portfolio to go public, and that Verlinvest had pushed Oatly's management toward China, bringing in China Resources as a partner.
deep_cut_fact: Before private equity he was Global Marketing VP and China Commercial Head at Anheuser-Busch InBev (2003-2008), and before that an Associate Partner at McKinsey & Company (1999-2003).
notes: Company bios differ on Verlinvest dates (Vita Coco page: MD Aug 2008-Feb 2024, now Senior Advisor; Oatly page: Senior Advisor Mar 2024-Jun 2025). Best route likely via Oatly/Vita Coco IR or Verlinvest. Investor bio pages blocked automated fetch; facts taken from search extracts of them.
